verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox or test environment for exercising Open WebUI separately from production data, such as a test instance, mock data mode, or isolated staging workspace. The Tether "workspace sandbox" only scopes which files the AI can work in, and ENV=dev only exposes Swagger docs. Self-hosting a second instance would be a user-side workaround. None of these is the product's own sandbox-testing capability, and no dry-run mode is documented either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
